early_stop_logic: If at least 9 of the 20 candidates are definitively ineligible under pre-frozen semantic/provenance rules, then at most 11 can remain and the >=12 gate is unreachable. Uncertain candidates need not be forced into PASS/HOLD categories to establish the gate result.

finite_family_consequence: Do not lower the >=12 threshold and do not introduce a third primary interaction source.
interpretation: GloBI contains abundant interaction records and 20 namespaces with correct-grain structural support, but the pre-frozen semantic/provenance requirements make the required >=12 independent replicated ecological programmes unreachable before any turnover outcome is opened.
